events.outcome: Current IF Mobile pricing remains available, but the prior remote image-plus-selfie identity flow ended 2026-03-31; current nonresident remote signup and mainland-China SMS utility remain unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: IF Mobile currently lists seven voice-SIM tiers, with the 1GB tier at JPY1,408/month. Its former web identity flow based on uploaded identity-document images plus a face image ended on 2026-03-31; current web applications must use JPKI or IC-chip reading plus face verification, with an in-store same-day counter as the documented alternative. A current passport-only nonresident web path is not established.

keep.action: Maintain the current 1GB voice-SIM subscription at JPY1,408/month. Current evidence does not establish a cheaper idle/PAYG number-retention mode.

data.chinaActivation: Current direct new-customer activation from mainland China is unproven after the 2026 identity-verification change. Independent user evidence documents an already-acquired IF Mobile line working in Taiwan for calls and SMS, but that does not prove a current post-change remote signup path or mainland-China activation.
data.kyc: The old upload-an-ID-image + selfie web method ended 2026-03-31. Current official options are My Number/JPKI, IC-chip reading + face verification, or the in-store same-day counter. The provider has not been verified to expose a current passport-only nonresident web route.
data.payment: The current site states that a credit card is not required, but the exact current remote payment path for an overseas new applicant is not reconciled.
data.roamingSms: Independent user evidence documents SMS/call reception in Taiwan on an existing line. Current provider-controlled roaming/SMS pricing and mainland-China OTP delivery are not verified.
data.holdReason: The legacy passport-image/selfie remote KYC claim is obsolete after 2026-03-31. Current JPKI/IC-chip/in-store identity methods are documented, but a current passport-only nonresident signup path and mainland-China overseas-SMS behavior are not established.
data.tariffSummary: Current 1GB voice SIM is JPY1,408/month; old image+face web KYC ended 2026-03-31, and current nonresident remote eligibility remains unresolved.
guideSteps: Treat the JPY1,408/month tier as current pricing, not the older JPY1,080 community figure.
Do not use the pre-April passport-image/selfie flow as current signup guidance.
Re-open only when a post-change nonresident signup path and current overseas SMS behavior are independently reproduced.
